sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Carbon-Fiber Milling and Brushless Motor Integration of FPV Drones

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law, French civil law, and indigenous customary law (Constitution of Vanuatu Art. 47; Laws of Vanuatu Act [CAP 132])
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus - Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (regional FTA in force 2020)
Melanesian Spearhead Group Trade Agreement (preferential trade)
New Zealand-Vanuatu Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2010)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [CAP 222] (as amended by the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2022 and the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership Information) Regulations); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act [CAP 290] as amended through the 2021-2024 AML/CFT Reform Package; Registered Agents and Trustees Act [CAP 223]; Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [CAP 272]; administered by the VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the document origin country; attested by the competent foreign-affairs authority and the Vanuatu consular post
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the last 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Origin-country utility provider or licensed financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarization followed by Vanuatu consular attestation; no apostille route available)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference or professional reference letter for each proposed director and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Account-holding bank or licensed professional body in the country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all subscribers, directors, UBOs, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK Sanctions List, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions notices issued by the Minister of Foreign Affairs. Continuous monitoring via licensed electronic KYC databases; PEP identification triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and senior-management sign-off; suspicious transactions must be reported to the VFIU within statutory timelines under the AML/CFT Act.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Electronic Company Registry / e-Services Portal (www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Latin (Roman) script; Bislama, English, or French names are permissible. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Société Anonyme', or an approved abbreviation. Non-Latin script names (e.g., Chinese, Russian, Arabic) must be transliterated into Latin script for the registered English name; a parallel foreign-language name may be recorded only as a secondary non-registered alias.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Partnership (when implying partnership status in a limited company)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: a name reservation may be extended once for an additional 30 days if the application is lodged with the VFSC before expiry, subject to a renewal fee and continued name availability. Rejection appeal: the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice, attaching justification and evidence of no conflict; the Registrar must decide within 14 days. If the administrative appeal is refused, judicial review is available before the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Judicial Review Act [CAP 200]. Practical fallback: file a fresh reservation with a modified distinguishing element (e.g., 'Velocitec FPV Racing Drones Ltd.').

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible with statutory limitation: an International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; the registered agent's office is the statutory address and may serve as the virtual office for correspondence. Remote management and e-commerce operations are permissible provided no business is transacted with Vanuatu-resident counterparties and the economic substance declaration is properly filed under the International Companies (Economic Substance) (Amendment) Act 2022.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated annual probability of unannounced physical inspection below 5% for a low-risk e-commerce/FPV drone retail trading entity without local operational premises; VFSC inspections are risk-based and are typically triggered by AML/CFT alerts, sanctions hits, complaints, or periodic registered-agent compliance file reviews.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 2009, as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2012, ss. 7-9 (incorporation, registered office, articles), s. 13 (company name), s. 17 (shares and capital), s. 18 (directors and members); International Companies (Fees) Regulations; Companies (Registration of International Companies) Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Registry Division, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 Application for Registration of an International Company together with the Articles of Incorporation (filed with the VFSC).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorized or paid-up capital is prescribed; shares may be denominated in any currency, may be issued partly paid, and no statutory escrow or capitalization bank account is required prior to registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscription of the founding member is approved, and 100 ordinary shares of VUV 1,000 each are allotted, fully paid, to the subscriber. RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company shall be situated at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, and the registered agent is appointed. RESOLVED, that the directors identified in the Articles are appointed, and, on behalf of the Company, are authorized to open bank accounts, engage PayPal, Stripe and alternative payment processors, and execute supplier and customer contracts for carbon-fiber milling and FPV drone assembly. RESOLVED, that the incorporation filings and all actions taken prior to the date hereof are ratified; the corporate seal is adopted; and share certificates are issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila; name reservation processed through VFSC Companies Registry index.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a licensed Vanuatu registered agent; instruct the agent to perform a name search against the VFSC company index, file a name reservation request, and compile know-your-client dossiers for each subscriber and director.
required_dossiers: Completed name reservation application
Certified copy of passport of each subscriber and director
Banker's or professional reference letter
Proposed authorized capital and share structure statement
Consent to act as registered agent from the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused as undesirable or conflicting, submit up to three alternative names within two business days with no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and authorized notary public, Port Vila, Vanuatu.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Articles of Incorporation, including the company name, registered office address, authorized and issued share capital, director and member particulars, and powers of the company; all signatures are witnessed or notarized and documents are dated for submission.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Incorporation
Consent to act as director (Form 3)
Consent to act as member and share subscription schedule
Registered office consent from the licensed agent
Notarized proof of residential address of each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries signature attestation or article formatting, re-execute the corrected instrument before a notary within five business days and refile without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing and Government Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Port Vila.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form 1 Application for Registration together with the certified Articles of Incorporation and consents through the VFSC filing counter or authorized electronic portal; pay the statutory government fee of approximately USD 250 and obtain the VFSC receipt.
required_dossiers: Form 1 Application for Registration of an International Company
Certified copy of the executed Articles of Incorporation
Evidence of payment of the USD 250 government filing fee
Registered agent undertaking and address confirmation
KYC documents for each director and member
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for deficiencies, rectify the identified defects within 14 business days; a late filing charge of VUV 5,000 is imposed only if registration is not completed within the statutory window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the company registration number and certified Articles; the registered agent verifies the registered name, capital, and officers, and retrieves certified sealed copies for the company record book.
required_dossiers: VFSC filing fee receipt
Approved Articles of Incorporation
Agent submission cover letter
Verification checklist signed by the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a naming, date, or officer transcription error, submit a correction request with the original certificate and pay the nominal replacement fee; the corrected certificate is issued within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Tax Exemption Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors, licensed registered agent, and VFSC Tax Exemption Unit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma first board resolutions, issue share certificates, open the statutory register of members and the register of directors, and apply to VFSC for a Certificate of Tax Exemption to confirm non-resident tax status.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
First board meeting minutes and resolutions
Share certificates and share transfer ledger
Register of members and register of directors
Application for Certificate of Tax Exemption
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If governance filings are incomplete, adopt supplemental board resolutions ratifying the omissions and file the corrected registers through the registered agent; no administrative penalty applies where cure occurs within the six-month voluntary compliance period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Business Licence Office, Department of Finance and Treasury, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Republic of Vanuatu; investment facilitation support from the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence - Manufacturing and Retail Trading for Carbon-Fiber Composite Products and FPV Drone Systems (no separate VFSC financial services licence applies to this non-financial business scope).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management, Republic of Vanuatu.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Preliminary Environmental Assessment and Environmental Registration required for small-scale carbon-fiber milling and electronics assembly; a Full EIA Report is mandated only if production capacity exceeds the prescribed threshold or the premises are located within a sensitive environmental buffer zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with the Environment Management and Conservation Act 2012, Waste Management Regulations 2018, and applicable emissions thresholds: respirable carbon-fiber dust below 3 mg/m3 (8-hour TWA) in the workplace; stack particulate emissions limited to 0.15 mg/Nm3; VOC filtration to below 50 mg/m3; prohibition of untreated wastewater discharge into waterways; hazardous resin and solvent waste handled under Basel Convention procedures and exported only to authorized facilities; site boundary noise not exceeding 55 dB(A) in daytime residential vicinity.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Means-of-Escape Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VFES); structural load and machine-foundation inspection certificate issued by the municipal Physical Planning and Building Control authority; Workplace Health and Safety clearance under the Health at Work Act 2015 administered by the Department of Labour, covering machine guarding, dust extraction, PPE, first-aid provision, and emergency response planning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs & Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu (Port Vila); official portal: customs.gov.vu. Responsibility covers VAT administration, excise, and customs duties. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately incorporates and supervises International Companies through licensed registered agents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no income tax, so no corporate income-tax TIN is issued; the operative identifier is the VFSC incorporation number for an International Company (IC). VAT identification numbers are procured as follows: (1) Incorporate the IC under the International Companies Act 1992 via a VFSC-licensed registered agent (no minimum capital, 100% non-resident ownership permitted, registered office in Port Vila or Luganville); (2) If the IC will make taxable supplies within Vanuatu or wishes to claim input VAT credits on local purchases, file the prescribed VAT registration application with the Department of Customs & Inland Revenue, appointing a resident tax representative when no local office exists; (3) The Department validates the constitutional documents, registered-agent confirmation, and premises evidence, then issues a VAT registration certificate and VAT identification number; (4) The IC activates the VAT ID by issuing sequentially numbered tax invoices from the effective registration date.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone. An International Company is a non-resident, tax-exempt limited company: exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding taxes, stamp duty, and inheritance/gift taxes, with a statutory 20-year immunity from future Vanuatu taxation after incorporation. The IC may not carry on business with Vanuatu residents, own land, or transact domestically in Vatu; all income is offshore-source and, when supplied goods/services are exported, falls outside the domestic VAT net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist because Vanuatu has no direct tax regime. Elective mechanisms available: (i) voluntary VAT registration below the statutory threshold to recover input VAT on export-support costs; (ii) redomiciliation/continuation of a foreign or domestic company as an International Company, or reverse redomiciliation, subject to VFSC approval under the International Companies Act 1992; (iii) an IC may obtain a written compliance ruling from the Department confirming the zero-rating or exemption treatment of a defined export program.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual taxable turnover for supplies of goods or VUV 3,000,000 annual taxable turnover for supplies of services, measured on a rolling 12-month prospective test in Vanuatu Vatu (VUV). An IC engaged exclusively in offshore export activity will generally remain below threshold absent a domestic supply nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, no electronic fiscal device mandate, no API-based clearance, and no digital stamping regime. Registered VAT suppliers must issue sequentially numbered tax invoices (paper, PDF, or ERP-generated) containing the prescribed particulars: supplier name, address, VAT ID, invoice date, description, quantity, unit price, VAT amount, and a visible 0% notation for zero-rated exports. VAT returns are filed electronically through the Department's online portal; invoices and underlying records must be retained for the statutory retention period and produced on audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods (FPV racing drones, carbon-fiber airframes, brushless motors, spare parts): zero-rated where the supplier exports, or supplies to an exporter who exports, the goods from Vanuatu for delivery to a non-resident, with physical export completed within 28 days of supply (or an extended period approved by the Commissioner) and freight evidenced to a final destination outside Vanuatu. Services: zero-rated where the recipient is a non-resident outside Vanuatu at the time of supply and the benefit or use is wholly outside Vanuatu (e.g., international logistics, engineering design for overseas assembly, software downloads, warranty support), or where services are supplied directly in connection with exported movable goods. The exporter must retain conclusive export evidence to support the 0% rate and any input VAT refund claim.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (finalized Vanuatu Customs export entry)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (or courier manifest for postal/express exports) evidencing physical export and destination
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit confirmation of foreign-currency payment settlement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Department of Customs & Inland Revenue reconciles zero-rating claims against customs export entries, freight documentation, and banking settlement records. Unsupported or non-exported supplies are re-assessed at 12.5% VAT with statutory late-payment interest, a late-payment penalty, and a civil penalty commonly set up to 150% of the tax shortfall for fraud or gross negligence; criminal prosecution under the Value Added Tax Act and Customs Act may result in significant fines and terms of imprisonment. Excess input VAT refunds are withheld pending audit verification and are clawed back with penalties where the underlying export evidence fails. An International Company that abuses its exemption through prohibited domestic trading is exposed to VFSC strike-off, loss of statutory tax-exempt status, and personal civil liability of directors.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains an open currency regime for both current and capital accounts. The Vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for most transactions, and profit remittances by International Companies to non-residents are generally permitted without quantitative restrictions. Capital account inflows and outflows above material thresholds require approval from an authorised dealer bank or the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu, but no prior foreign exchange regime licence is required for equity injection or trade disbursements. The practical constraint is bank-level compliance rather than statutory convertibility limitations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no mandatory percentage conversion ratio for export proceeds in Vanuatu. The Exchange Control Act imposes an obligation on resident exporters to offer foreign currency to an authorised dealer within one month of receipt unless an extension is granted; International Companies are generally treated as non-resident entities and may retain export proceeds in a designated foreign currency account without surrender to the Central Bank. For commercial goods leaving Vanuatu, the exporter must repatriate payment within 180 days of shipment and maintain supporting shipping documentation for bank verification.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility as a primary treasury rail. Offshore digital EMI platforms are not licensed by the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu and cannot hold a Vanuatu International Company's escrowed capital or act as an authorised dealer. They may be used only as ancillary collection wallets for PayPal/Stripe payouts, subject to the EMI's own KYC restrictions and potential FATF-driven due diligence requirements on Vanuatu entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of directors in Vanuatu is not a statutory command, but each licensed bank may impose an in-person or video-conference KYC interview before opening the account. In practice, banks such as ANZ and BSP will remote-open for a non-resident International Company if the beneficial owners complete an interactive video interview, present notarised passports, proof of source of funds, and a corporate register extract certified by a Vanuatu registered agent. A physical visit is strongly recommended to shorten the onboarding timeline and satisfy the Financial Intelligence Unit's enhanced due diligence expectations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of economic substance / tax-exempt IC status perceived as a potential shell company red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fiscal year financial statements, registered office lease agreement, corporate minutes, certificate of good standing from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and a detailed operative business plan covering carbon-fibre milling, motor integration, and FPV drone retail sales.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership chain involving nominee shareholders or remote directors.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full corporate ownership chart, passport copies and proof of residential address for each ultimate beneficial owner, bank reference letters, trust deed (if applicable), and curriculum vitae demonstrating an operational role in the drone business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dual-use product category for drone components triggering export-control or sanctions review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Technical specification sheet confirming consumer FPV racing drone design, ECCN classification (typically EAR99) and/or US Commerce ruling, Vanuatu Customs tariff heading 8802/9503, ISIC 3240 bill of materials, and a no-military-use attestation signed by the managing director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border transactions via e-commerce rails (PayPal/Stripe) creating unexpected transaction-pattern anomalies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed software service agreement and platform dashboard registration, PCI-DSS compliance certificate, chargeback ratio history, and a written treasury policy linking customer sales inflows to supplier disbursements for drone components.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Initial shareholder capital should be injected via SWIFT MT103 using the bank's internal purpose code for equity contribution (or, where required, a BPM6 'investment in equity' code). The authorised dealer will require a board resolution authorising the account, source-of-funds documents, and confirmation of the outstanding share allotment. Funds must clear through a recognised correspondent before being credited; for amounts above VUV 50 million (approximately USD 400,000), the bank will file a statistical notification with the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements are predominately SWIFT MT103 customer credits for supplier invoices. For component imports on open account, the Vanuatu IC will issue MT103 transfers from its operational account to the supplier's bank; for larger purchase orders, a commercial letter of credit (MT700) can be issued through a Vanuatu licensed bank, although fees are excessive relative to the business scale. Retail payments from global customers (card rails) are collected via PayPal and Stripe and then swept to the Vanuatu bank account as a business-settlement withdrawal using the platform's standard payout method and documented as 'online retail income'.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot VUV/USD foreign exchange transactions with a licensed Vanuatu authorised dealer for immediate cash-flow matching
Simple currency forward contracts on VUV/USD with tenors up to 12 months, subject to bank product availability and margin requirements
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on VUV/USD through offshore counterparties, permitted only to hedge genuine commercial exposure evidenced by underlying invoices and purchase orders
Cross-currency swaps (VUV/USD) for transaction sizes above USD 1,000,000, requiring explicit Reserve Bank of Vanuatu prior approval and contemporaneous hedge documentation

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Renewal for International Company (Exempt Company Certificate Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via Licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; renewal window opens 30 days prior to anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual government fee applies immediately after the anniversary date; continued non-payment for 3 consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution of the International Company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Confirmation of Good Standing and Register Maintenance Attestation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the Appointed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually concurrent with the Annual Government Fee Renewal; no separate public filing deadline applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain registered agent triggers VFSC administrative sanction and potential strike-off; the company cannot obtain Certificate of Good Standing until cured

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempt Company Tax Status Attestation (Tax Exemption Certificate Renewal Record)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR) – informational record only; no tax return filed for non-resident International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation maintained by registered agent in company records; no statutory tax return deadline within Vanuatu
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with record-keeping obligations only; International Companies remain exempt from Vanuatu income tax, withholding tax, and capital gains tax regardless of filing status

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to Vanuatu International Companies under the International Companies Act; audits are required only if the company's Constitution expressly mandates audit or if an audit is requested by shareholders holding at least 10% of voting rights, or mandated by a licensed bank or financing counterparty
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies may maintain accounts under any recognized accounting framework; IFRS is the prevailing standard for companies preparing audited financial statements, while simplified internal records are accepted for exempt companies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a current register of beneficial owners at the registered office; no annual UBO filing is submitted to VFSC, but the agent must verify and record any share transfer within 14 days of notification and reconfirm UBO details at least annually as part of the renewal process

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 800 – USD 1,500 per annum for licensed registered agent and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800 – USD 3,500 per annum if voluntarily prepared under IFRS; USD 0 where no audit is procured

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Absolute statutory exemption for International Companies under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), s.138: the VU IC is exempt from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, business licence tax, payroll tax, and stamp duty on its instruments. Global revenue from carbon-fibre milling, brushless-motor integration, and FPV racing drone retail is taxed at an effective rate of 0%. No withholding tax is levied on distributions, interest, royalties, or management fees paid by the IC.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: None — Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax. The Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue issues no CIT return form applicable to an International Company; the IC's exemption is evidenced by its certificate of incorporation and the s.138 statutory exemption.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable — no CIT return is due for a VU IC. The only recurring statutory formalities are the VFSC annual return and, where opted in, the monthly VAT return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No income, profit, gain, or distribution is taxable, chargeable, or reportable to Vanuatu revenue authorities in respect of the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors file no Vanuatu income tax return, obtain no TIN, and require no tax clearance for the IC's offshore drone trading activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Not applicable — failure to file a non-existent CIT return attracts no penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC International Company Annual Return (IC Form 3) — lodged electronically with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC Online) by the licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: First annual return within 12 months of incorporation; thereafter within 14 days of each anniversary of incorporation (International Companies Act, Cap 222, ss.103–104).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number and legal name exactly as shown on the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent enters the full legal name; a foreign-trading name or DBA for the drone brand may be noted separately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Vanuatu (physical street address, not a P.O. box), maintained by the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company may not maintain a local registered office independently; the licensed agent's address satisfies this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed registered agent name, licence number, and confirmation of ongoing engagement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent self-certifies compliance with AML/CFT vetting of the non-resident beneficial owner.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors: full names, addresses, nationalities, and dates of appointment or resignation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident; no work permit or residency is required, but each director's identity documents must be held by the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders and share register: classes and number of shares issued, with percentage holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership details of the non-resident shareholder must be disclosed to the agent for the VFSC AML database.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised share capital expressed in vatu or other permitted currency.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No minimum paid-up capital applies to a VU IC; a nominal authorised capital is acceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company secretary or other officers (optional for ICs).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: May be an individual or corporate body; nationality and address are required, not residency.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal activity declaration: confirms the offshore scope (ISIC 3240 manufacture and retail of racing hobby drones) and confirms no business with Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This field is the critical gatekeeper: the agent must verify that no supply chain, customer, or premises touches the Vanuatu domestic market, preserving the IC's tax-exempt status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fee of VT 25,000 plus VT 5,000 per additional month of default. Default exceeding 12 months exposes the IC to compulsory strike-off and dissolution under ss.104–105, with all assets vesting in the State; restoration requires a court order and payment of arrears.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu VAT Return (Value Added Tax Act, Cap 272) — filed electronically with the Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: On or before the 15th day of the month following the end of each VAT reporting period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output tax at 12.5% on taxable supplies made within Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An IC deriving export revenue from FPV drones supplied outside Vanuatu declares nil output tax; exports are zero-rated and remain outside the IC's VAT base.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credits on imported goods and local expenses incurred in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident costs (overseas milling, motors, logistics) carry no Vanuatu VAT and generate no credit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net VAT payable or refundable for the month.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A pure offshore trader will report zero net VAT unless goods are physically imported into Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Zero-rated export declaration: value of exported drone goods.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Requires documentary evidence of shipment (bills of lading, courier manifests) for the PayPal/Stripe sales flow.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment surcharge of 10% of the tax due plus monthly interest penalty; late filing and evasion offences carry fines up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu statutes impose no dividend withholding tax; distributions declared by the VU IC to its non-resident shareholder are paid gross and free of Vanuatu tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network; the limited Vanuatu–Australia arrangement (2007) and Vanuatu–New Zealand investment provisions do not operate a relief-at-source mechanism because the domestic dividend WHT is already nil. To support a foreign tax credit or tax-sparing claim in the shareholder's home jurisdiction, the registered agent may procure a VFSC tax residency certificate endorsed with the IC's name and exemption status; there is no Vanuatu administrative form for 'treaty relief', TRC pre-clearance, or advance tax ruling for outbound dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on IP royalties (including FPV flight-control software licences and brand royalties) and 0% on debt interest (intercompany loans). No treaty reduction is required or available because the domestic rate is already zero and no DTA network exists to further reduce it.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation, no arm's-length documentation requirements, and no Local File/Master File concept. The de facto threshold is VT 0; related-party sales of drone components and intercompany IP licences are documented only under the IC's general books-and-records duty and the registered agent's AML/KYC file.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act No. 9 of 2024 and the 2025 Regulation Order impose substance obligations only on ICs undertaking defined relevant activities: banking, insurance, investment fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, shipping, distribution and service centres, holding companies, and IP exploitation. Carbon-fibre milling, brushless-motor integration, and retail sale of FPV racing drones are manufacturing and trading activities and do not constitute a relevant activity unless the IC separately contracts as a Vanuatu-licensed distribution or service centre for affiliated foreign entities. A pure third-party e-commerce IC satisfies the regime with a registered office, a resident registered agent, and books and records maintained in Vanuatu; no local employment or physical premises are required.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of IC Tax-Exempt Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC's zero-tax status while actually carrying on business with Vanuatu residents (e.g., domestic drone sales, local warehousing, or leasing premises in Port Vila) or holding beneficial interests in Vanuatu land, contrary to the International Companies Act (Cap 222), s.5.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Forfeiture of the s.138 exemption; retrospective assessment and clawback of all taxes that would have applied had the entity been a domestic Vanuatu company; criminal fine up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years on conviction under s.130.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised local trading are jointly and severally liable for clawed-back taxes and fines; courts may order civil restitution of offshore profits, impose travel bans, and sentence directors to imprisonment up to 2 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Sustained failure to file the VFSC Annual Return and pay annual fees beyond 12 months post-anniversary, leaving the IC as an abandoned shell with no registered agent confirmation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Late fee of VT 25,000 plus VT 5,000 per month; compulsory strike-off and dissolution under ss.104–105; bank balances, receivables, and IP assets vest in the State; restoration requires a court order, payment of all arrears, and fresh AML vetting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a struck-off company lose standing to defend proceedings in Vanuatu courts; they become personally liable for the IC's outstanding obligations, may be disqualified from holding office for up to 5 years, and face travel restrictions when the VFSC files enforcement proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Certifying to the VFSC that the IC maintains Vanuatu substance or performs a relevant activity, when in fact it is managed and controlled entirely from Hong Kong, Singapore, or Dubai, in order to obtain bank or payment-rail (PayPal/Stripe) onboarding that hinges on a substance certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2024 (up to VT 5,000,000 per default), mandatory deregistration of the IC, nullification of the false certificate, and compulsory reporting of the misrepresentation to foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, registered agents, and beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for penalties; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 5 years, travel bans, passport surrender, and confiscation of the IC's assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Money Laundering on Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using PayPal or Stripe sales flows linked to racing-drone transactions to layer or conceal proceeds of credit-card fraud, or operating the IC without beneficial-ownership records at the registered agent, in breach of the Anti-Money Laundering Act No. 24 of 2020 and the Proceeds of Crime Act (Cap 279).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money laundering conviction: imprisonment up to 20 years and fines at the court's discretion; corporate AML compliance breaches: penalties up to VT 25,000,000; VFSC may freeze e-money accounts, issue transaction blocking orders, and order civil confiscation of laundered funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced for directors and beneficial owners who knowingly control laundering operations; they face personal criminal prosecution, civil restitution and disgorgement, travel bans, asset-freezing orders, and imprisonment up to 20 years.
